rationale: Desugars u128::to_be_bytes into big-endian shift/mask operations and uses the smaller public constructor because Ipv6Addr's octets field is private. The supplied contract snippet is the adjacent Ipv4Addr::to_bits contract; the proof uses the actual Ipv6Addr::from_bits postcondition.
